notes.generated_support: generated means parser/compiler output is structurally usable; it is not a runtime confirmation. The solver must still gate every operation through this matrix.
notes.gain_status: Canonical status operation. Legacy gain_status in card_rules.json is accepted by the runtime adapter but new v2 compiler output uses this name.
notes.remove_abilities: Removes all printed and granted abilities from the selected permanent. The runtime stores an explicit abilities_removed flag; delayed effects still remain a planned boundary.
notes.modify_damage_taken: Leader damage-taken delta (for example, 'Takes 1 more damage'). Permanent current-turn modifiers are executable; expiry is reported as incomplete.
notes.modify_previous_effect: Schema-only relation for replacement text such as 'instead'; it is never confirmation-safe until attached to a concrete base effect.
notes.add_to_zone: Explicit destination-aware insertion. Use add_to_hand only when destination is hand.
notes.split: Legacy alias. New compiler output must use ordered_split.
notes.ordered_split: Assign damage in enemy board order, moving to the next follower only after lethal damage is assigned.
notes.random: Probability-preserving execution is implemented for random target, repeat, draw and deck summon selectors when the public pool is known; hidden pools remain incomplete.
notes.copy: copy requires a source selector, destination, and count. copy_mode=exact with preserve_state=true denotes an entity snapshot (including current attack/life, damage, keywords, and evolve state); card/printed copies use catalog identity only.
notes.resource_selector: Dynamic summon/copy effects retain zone, side, selection, filters, and optional distinct_by instead of guessing a concrete card_id.
notes.previous_add: Target scope for the card most recently created by add_to_hand; used when a following set_cost changes the generated card rather than the source card.
notes.spellboost: Implemented for public hand entities. Each event increments spell_boost_count and dispatches on_spellboost in hand order; random hand selectors branch uniformly.
notes.reanimate: Implemented for follower identities present in destroyed_this_match. Cost/tribe/class filters and multiplicity are honored; an absent pool is reanimate_unknown_pool. Reanimate samples without consuming the pool entry and does not decrement cemetery/Shadow, so repeated effects can select the same entry again.
notes.transform: Implemented for static catalog targets and random targets from a public deck distribution. Hidden deck mass emits transform_unknown; no deck card is removed because the selector is sampled as a template. Dynamic opponent-deck/unknown selectors remain incomplete.
notes.replicate_ability: Implemented for one-level replication of another ability on the same card (normally Fanfare into Evolve/Engage). Missing, conditional-unknown, or recursively nested source abilities report an explicit replicate_* gap.
notes.keywords: The vocabulary is closed at the schema boundary. Only Storm, Rush, and Ward are currently materialized by the lethal runtime; other canonical keywords remain schema-valid but planned and cannot be used by a verified rule.
